name: The DUNE Far Detector Interim Design Report Volume 1: Physics, Technology and Strategies
notes: doc_type is recorded as technical_design_report: the enum (§3.13) has no "interim design report" value. This report predates and was superseded by the Feb 2020 Far Detector TDR series (document:dune-fd-tdr-vol-1..4).

summary.plain: An interim milestone report on DUNE's far-detector design, written between the early conceptual work and the final 2020 technical design reports.
summary.technical: DUNE FD IDR Vol. 1 (arXiv:1807.10334, Jul 2018): physics motivation, technology choices and strategy for the far detector, superseded by the 2020 TDR volumes.
